answer_1.quote: Specifically, given an image and a question querying spatial quantities in the image, the model needs to directly output the estimated quantities in text format
answer_1.outputs: Text responses with scalar and unit for spatial quantities

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance in success rate by thresholding the maximum ratio between an estimation and a ground truth value

answer_3.quote: To do this, we feed the sampled GPT-4o responses to a separate GPT-4o instance which we prompt to determine if a model response uses any reference object as guidance
methods: Binary classification for reference object usage

answer_4.quote: To gauge the difficulty of the introduced benchmark, Q-Spatial Bench, we ask three humans to perform quantitative spatial reasoning. Each human answer a sampled set of 40 quantitative spatial reasoning questions
answer_4.guideline: Humans answered spatial questions and success rate was measured using δ ≤2
